identity.instance: process PID plus random UUID; renewed on process start

embedded_worker.name: redis_subscriber
embedded_worker.heartbeat: after completed poll/dispatch, including empty polls

dependencies.name: postgresql
dependencies.probe: read-only selection of telemetry_context from wallet/payments outbox

dependencies.name: redis
dependencies.critical: when PAYMENT_EVENT_TRANSPORT=redis_stream; optional for callback-oriented payment API

dependencies.name: payment_providers
dependencies.probe: none; only actual business calls instrumented

metrics.authentication: Bearer, fail-closed with missing token; direct socket peer CIDR allowlist in central profile
metrics.transport: HTTPS via reviewed private TLS gateway; plaintext only inside explicitly isolated local network
metrics.canonical_source: native producer; never add recording aliases duplicating native diddi_* families
metrics.additional_metrics: Existing diddipay_* business metrics and Python runtime metrics retained; never financial source of truth

logs.transport: one-line UTF-8 JSON stderr; one central Docker log pipeline per source
logs.redaction: recursive sensitive keys, credentials/URLs/email/phone/IP patterns; bounded depth and breadth; no raw HTTP access line
logs.correlation_indexing: request_id/trace_id/span_id are JSON fields, never Loki labels
logs.remaining_limits: Free-form messages cannot prove universal PII removal; synthetic cases tested; manual CLI stdout excluded from deployed runtime profile

traces.generic_endpoint_variable: TRACING_OTLP_ENDPOINT or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT; appends /v1/traces exactly once
traces.ca_reference: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CERTIFICATE mounted file, optional for public PKI
traces.public_boundary: central ingress must enforce trusted sampling; not yet validated
traces.memory_budget: bounded item count; conservative 128 MiB telemetry process allowance to validate under real load; local measured peak in evidence/outage.json includes test harness
traces.retry: SDK 1.44 OTLP bounded deadline, exponential backoff/jitter; no durable producer spool; Retry-After honored across batches; OTLP partial rejections counted
traces.delivery: best effort; queue overflow drops oldest, failed exports counted; recovery sends new spans, lost spans not replayed
traces.sanitization: allowlisted method/status/route/messaging metadata; URLs, peer addresses, raw events/status text removed before queue

async.storage: nullable telemetry_context JSONB column in both outboxes
async.policy: new consumer trace per attempt with link to original publication; HTTP client child propagated to callback; Redis stream metadata separate from signed event; inbound Redis PubSub extracts metadata
async.compatibility: signed callback body unchanged; legacy rows without metadata create unlinked spans; consumers outside this repository require coordinated validation

central_values_required: OTLP credentials and CA if private PKI

retention_days.backup_exports: central expiration policy required; not implemented here

slo: not defined or approved for v1; legacy example SLO rules are not central policy
not_applicable: No scheduler container or recurring cron jobs declared; next execution/deadline not applicable to continuous worker
Redis Stream consumer backlog: this module publishes only, consumers belong to other modules; its durable delivery backlog is payments_outbox
blocking_external_validation: C06/C07 cross-service traversal on deployed revision
C10 representative business load on isolated staging
C12 central retention/backups/alert routing/ownership and cardinality capacity measurement
